evidence.note: Documents the rendered GEMINI.md import of AGENTS.md, the 26 namespaced command files, the untranslated hooks, and the doc citations for each format.
Records the support level and limits of each runtime surface.

limits: C2 is manual-gated compatibility (conformance level Partial), not native parity with Claude Code or protected-workflow certification.
No Tess hook is translated: in-session gates do not run under Gemini CLI; the ship-gate runs at git pre-push and in CI.
Project context and commands load only in a trusted folder; the workspace policy tier is not rendered (gemini-cli issue 18186).
Verified by install, help, config smoke and the CLI's own loaders only; no live model run and no local process driver.
The adapter cannot mint approvals, verifier keys, verdicts, sign-offs, or branch-protection status.
